title: SessionCapabilities
description: Closed vocabularies for the content-less compatibility handshake on POST /api/v1/sessions: the capability list a client declares and the Backend advertises, the run environment, and the closed refusal codes. All values come from fixed lists; nothing here carries customer text. The Backend tells a content-less session from a legacy one by the PRESENCE of `content_less_v1` in the request `capabilities`; no second request contract is needed because every field below is additive and optional.

SessionCapability.description: A session-contract capability. `content_less_v1`: the client sends only the content-less shapes (opaque refs, closed enums) for every route group the Backend has shipped, and never falls back to plaintext. The list is closed and grows only by a reviewed contract change.

SessionEnvironment.description: Run environment of the optimization session. A closed enum, never a free label (free text is content on this channel). `production` is never guessed by a client: it is sent only when explicitly configured. Absent means `default`.

OptimizationRefusalCode.description: Closed refusal codes for the content-less compatibility matrix, carried in the error envelope's `error_code`. `client_upgrade_required`: the Backend refuses a legacy client (no `content_less_v1`) for a tenant past cutoff. `backend_upgrade_required`: raised by a content-less client that finds `content_less_v1` missing from the Backend's advertised capabilities; it never falls back to plaintext. `session_shape_legacy`: a content-less client tried to resume a session created with the legacy shape; it ends that session locally and starts a new one. A refusal never echoes the request.
